description: As q5670.json (the order-5670 quandle), except the F_3 block: a1 = I, a2 = J + 1 (J = [[1,1],[0,1]]), P = diag(2,1,1), g0 = (0,1,0). The third F_3 coordinate is inert (A and P fix it, g0 is 0 there); it keeps the block sizes of the checkers. The quandle is the orbit of c0 under conjugation by G, with x * y = y x y^-1.
